scope: Exact 5964 source tasks matched by SHA-256 to the archived closure ledger and 426 completed Batch 7 consensus rows matched by symbol.
omitted: Failed or superseded attempts, preview consensus runs, and 49 extra research synthesis requests. This is a completed-release footprint, not an all-attempts bill.

usage_semantics.gemini: prompt + candidate + thought; cache is a subset of input
usage_semantics.opus: input includes input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens; output includes thinking
usage_semantics.astra: input includes cache; output includes reasoning

limits: Provider-defined tokens, repeated/cached context and intermediate stages; not distinct research words, comparable compute units or evidence of quality.
